# Spring Boot LW POC
> Red Hat Lightwell Spring Boot 2.7.18 proof of concept on Java 17, built with Maven. API-first REST
> design with OpenAPI contract and sample greetings endpoint.

Stack: Spring Boot 2.7.18, Java 17, Maven. GroupId: `com.redhat.lightwell`. Base package: `com.redhat.lightwell`.
Dependencies: Red Hat Lightwell Network Maven repos via `settings.xml` (requires `LW_USERNAME`, `LW_PASSWORD`).

## Project context
- [Agent guide (AGENTS.md)](./AGENTS.md): Build commands, coding conventions, boundaries, and doc map for coding agents
- [README](./README.md): Human-oriented overview and component index
- [Maven settings](./settings.xml): Lightwell validated + remediated repository profiles

## Architecture & design
- [Architecture](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Layered design, API-first flow, Lightwell dependency resolution
- [REST API](./docs/API.md): API-first workflow, usage samples, and contract checklist
- [OpenAPI contract](./openapi/openapi.yaml): Authoritative REST specification (paths, schemas, examples)

## Development
- [Build, package, and run locally](./docs/BUILD-AND-RUN.md): Credentials, TLS, Maven goals, OpenAPI generation
- [Testing practices](./docs/TESTING.md): Unit and integration testing standards, tools, and naming
- [.mavenrc.example](./.mavenrc.example): Optional local Maven/JVM trust store template
